anupādiṇṇa.p:
[Na+upādiṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 1) The Dhamma which is not to be taken / believed in 2) The Kamma which is afflicted with passionate lust, misbelief. The Dhama which should not take advantage, which is being Anupādinna, not happened by Kamma. A) One of the Dhamma from Vipākanāmakkhandhā , physical make-up of a being as the consquence of one's past deeds.
